_README: Copy to config.local.json and edit. config.local.json is git-ignored and must never be committed. Every gate defaults to false; set one only when the matching decision has actually been approved, and record who approved it and when.
_publish_audience: Who receives the dashboard in ph_task. Never guessed - the publisher refuses to run with an empty audience. Use the exact ph_task spelling, e.g. Tharsika(jaffna).
_alerts: Required only once alert_delivery_approved is true. No delivery transport is implemented yet.
_priority_asins: Required only once priority_rule_approved is true. An explicit approved ASIN list - the engine will not infer one from analytics_asinsegmentasin.priority.
_secrets: No password or token belongs in this file. The publish password is read from $BBOX_PUBLISH_PASSWORD or $PGPASSWORD at runtime.
